title: TikTok says it plans to invest €1B to build a second data center in Finland as part of its €12B European data sovereignty initiative for the data of 200M+ users (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: TikTok says it plans to invest €1B to build a second data center in Finland as part of its €12B European data sovereignty initiative for the data of 200M+ users — TikTok plans to invest 1 billion euros ($1.16 billion) to build a second data centre in Finland in less than a year …
